༄༅/ /zhal gdams zhes bya ba bzhugs/oṃ swā sti/bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems gus ldan gyi slob ma khyed rnams la/ /snying padma 'dab brgyad kha pha

tei:div.tei:p: oṃ swā sti/ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems gus ldan gyi slob ma khyed rnams la/ /snying padma 'dab brgyad kha phye nas/ /don 'khrul med kyi gdams pa gsal por dgod/ /lar mi lus thob pa'i gnas skabs 'dir/ /chos rtse gcig nyams su ma blangs na/ /phyi lang ling chos kyis mi phan pas/ /blo nang du khug la nan tan mdzod/ /chos yod lo ngag gi stong zob 'dis/ /ma sems can thams cad bslus par 'gro/ /lus ngag yid chos dang mthun ma mthun/ /snying thag pas rtog dpyod yang yang 'tshal/ /mchog bla ma yin ring bsten pa yang*/ /las bsags pa rab la bdud rtsi yin/ /mi phal cher gdams ngag chos dred khyer/ /sems log ltas dkrugs nas dmyal bar 'gro/ khyed kun yang bla mas ci gsung sgrubs/ /de byas na 'dun ma rtse mor 'gro/ /phal gzhan gyi ngo dga'i dbang song na/ /tshe 'di phyi gnyis med sdug la skyel/ /sems nyams len nam mkha' ltar yangs la/ /phyi blang dor spyod pa zhib pa 'di/ /lar lta spyod 'dzoms pa dam pa'i mchog /rgyal ba sras bcas dgyes pa'i lam bzang yin/ /lus chos chas su zhugs pa'i rtsing spyod ni/ /nyams mtho yang gang la'ang mi phan pas/ /las tho chor ma song gnad du che/ /chos brgyud bcas kyi zhabs 'dren ma byas tsam/ /blo chags sdang zur mgo rags pa la/ / ming chos par btags kyang ga la phan/ /phung bdag 'dzin gyi mdud pa shigs kyis bshig /dbyings rtsol bral gyi ngang du lhod kyis glod/ /'phral zas gos don gnyer las med pa yi/ /skra bregs tsam gyi chos pa'i gzugs brnyan te/ /nang rang sems la ltas na yi mug ldang*/ /phyi skye bo'i mi kha dir re ba/ /lar dud 'gro dang khyad par mi gda' bas/ /zas zhim 'dod kyi sred pa spong ba dang*/ /gos legs 'dod kyi chos brgyad ma che bar/ /sprang dman cha bzung na legs pa yin/ /rang tshe gcig chos bzhin spyod pa na/ kha zhan zhan 'dra yang legs pa'i rab/ /nor cung zad bsogs kyang chos dang 'gal/

/de lha 'dre mi gsum la mngon lo 'phyar/ /dus nam zhig 'chi ba sleb dus su/ / nor mang yang ro nor ro gos shig /zas mang yang ro zas kham gang yin/ /rdzas longs spyod gzhan gyis sus thob byed/ /tshe phyi ma phan ched kyi gdeng med na/ / 'phral bzang bzang 'dra yang de kha'i rgyu/ /gnas bsam gtan khang bur tshugs pa dang*/ /yid chos la dga' bde rnyed pa dang*/ /'phral chos mthun gyi 'tsho bas mi brel bar/ /pha bla mas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ / zhes pa'ang tā ra nā thas g.yu nang gi ri la sdod pa'i sgom mo zhig la gdams pa'o/ / dar rgyas 'phel/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/tā ra nā tha'i gsung thor bu'i skor/ PAGE - - PAGE 13- PAGE 13 -- PAGE 12 -
